name: Min Ayam Maliha
overview:
A gentle, dreamy girl named Maliha moves to the capital to study at the university, where she meets Haider. Her close friend Najma meets Haider’s friend, and both men are businessmen.

Maliha experiences an incident that shocks her and reveals Haider’s true face. She and her friend Najma then decide to take revenge on him and his friend by trying to expose the secrets behind their suspicious business activities.
